name: Adonis
source:
After five years of absence, Arianne returns to her childhood town, Adonis, following the death of her grandmother, to help her mother empty the house.
There, she finds a mysterious bracelet that seems to possess a strange power: that of reading people's minds. Arianne will use it to discover the truth about the events surrounding the reason for her departure: the death of her brother. 

[Translated from [url=https://marc-nebout.itch.io/adonis]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
离开五年后，阿丽安在祖母去世后回到了童年的小镇阿多尼斯，帮助母亲清空房子。
在那里，她发现了一个神秘的手镯，它似乎拥有一种奇怪的力量：读心术。阿丽安将用它来发现围绕她离开原因的事件的真相：她哥哥的死。

[译自[url=https://marc-nebout.itch.io/adonis]Itch.io[/url]]
